children: Nvidia's acquisition of artificial intelligence startup Hugging Face is a strategic win for the company, Jefferies' analysts write. The roughly $13 billion deal for New York-based Hugging Face is financially immaterial for Nvidia, they say. But the deal will extend Nvidia's reach into the finding, testing and running of AI models, they say. The acquisition will also strengthen Nvidia's engagement with developers, and improve the Santa Clara-based chip company's ties into the open-model ecosystem, they say. Nvidia shares rise 0.8% premarket, after jumping 1.8% in the last session. (josephmichael.stonor@wsj.com)
